title: Optimal Quantum Feshbach Engines
summary: We develop an optimization framework for high-efficiency quantum cycles implemented with a trapped Bose-Einstein condensate, whose control parameters are the trap stiffness and the interaction strength tuned via a Feshbach resonance. Optimal driving protocols for each stroke of the cycle are obtained from a variational description of the condensate dynamics combined with Nelson's stochastic quantization, which maps the quantum evolution onto an effective Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process.
